fields.description: The filterable fields: type, label, validation schema, operators and options. Builds the conditions definition inline; it is exposed as `filters.definition`. Provide either `fields` or `definition`.

operators.description: Custom operator registry for the inline `fields` form.

definition.description: A conditions definition created with `defineConditions`, as an alternative to `fields` — use this when the definition is shared with non-UI code.

valueEditors.description: Value editors by field type, merged over the built-in string, number, date and option editors.

fieldValueEditors.description: Value editors for a specific field, taking precedence over the type editors.

operatorValueEditors.description: Value editors for a specific operator.

operatorLabels.description: Compact operator labels shown in the chips, merged over the built-in overrides (`gt` `>`, `gte` `≥`, `lt` `<`, `lte` `≤`). Unmapped operators use the operator label from the definition.

formatValue.description: Formats a committed value for display in a chip. Return `undefined` to fall back to the default formatting (option labels, localized dates, Yes/No booleans).

children.description: Replaces the default composition (chips, add button, clear button). Compose your own bar from `conditions.FilterChips`, `conditions.AddFilterButton` and `conditions.ClearFiltersButton`.

parentId.description: The condition group to add the condition to.

children.description: The button content. The button only renders while at least one filter is active.
